userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Salesforce User ID (005...) of the rep or manager. Blank defaults to session user.

forecastTypeId.title: Forecasting Type ID
forecastTypeId.description: Optional. Salesforce ID of an active ForecastingType already known from the calling page's context or the utterance (STEP 1.5). When supplied, it is validated and bound directly, skipping default resolution; an unknown id halts with an error. Blank means resolve it.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: Optional. Salesforce ID of a ForecastingPeriod already known from the calling page's context or the utterance (STEP 1.5). When supplied, it is validated and bound directly, skipping default resolution; an unknown id halts with an error. Blank means resolve it — always to the period bracketing today, silently.

territoryId.title: Territory ID
territoryId.description: Optional. Salesforce Territory2 ID already known from the calling page's context or the utterance (STEP 1.5), for territory-hierarchy ForecastingTypes. When supplied, it is validated against the resolved user's accessible territories and bound directly; a not-found or inaccessible id halts with an error. Blank means resolve it.

categoryApiNames.title: Category API Name
categoryApiNames.description: Optional. A single forecast category api name already known from the calling page's context or the utterance (STEP 1.5); a cell-specific request names exactly one category. When supplied, it is validated against the type's displayed categories and bound directly; a category not in the displayed set halts with an error. Blank "" means default to the type's forecastable displayed categories (Commit, Best Case, Pipeline; Closed/Most Likely/Omitted/Custom excluded).
